description: Prediction markets you can trade now (Polymarket): events with their markets and, per outcome, the CLOB token_id you trade and its price (a probability 0–1 = USD per share; a winning share pays $1). Default: by 24h volume. Optional: query (search), event_slug (one event), tag (a Gamma tag slug, e.g. sports, politics, crypto), limit (≤50), offset.

event_slug.description: Return one event by its slug (from an earlier listing)

tag.description: A Polymarket tag slug, e.g. sports, politics, crypto

name: list_prediction_markets
